DESCRIPTION:
• Waterproof and shockproof with a tough ABS plastic casing
• 10-foot cable with a stainless-steel probe
• One-key operation quickly recalls highest/lowest readings over any time period

Thermometer for wet areas. Water-resistant construction is ideal for wet labs, wash-down areas, outdoors, and virtually all field applications. Unit is engineered to be shockproof in drop tests up to 5 feet. Stainless-steel probe is resistant to most laboratory chemicals. Wide range covers 99 percent of the labs routine temperature measurements. Reading updates every second. Solid-state construction eliminates dangers inherent in breakable glass and toxic mercury thermometers. °F/°C switchable with minimum/maximum memory and easy-view LCD digits.

To assure accuracy an individually serial-numbered Traceable Certificate is provided from an ISO/IEC 17025 (1750.01) calibration laboratory accredited by A2LA. It indicates traceability to standards provided by NIST. Supplied: suction cups, magnets, Velcro, Traceable Certificate, and 1.5 volt silver-oxide battery (replacement battery, Cat. No. 350-18940).

Specifications:
• Temperature range: -50 to 300°C (-58 to 572°F)
• Temperature resolution: 0.1° from -19.9 to 199.9°C; otherwise 1°C
• No. of probes: 1 stainless steel probe
• Internal temperature accuracy: +/-1°C between -20 and 100°C
• Included probe range: -58 to 572°F (-50 to 300°C)
• Probe dimensions (dia. x L): 0.14 x 5 in.
• Cable length: 120 in.
• LCD digit size: 1/4 in
• Dimensions: 13/4 x 1/2 in.
• Weight: 11/2 ounces

† Not certified or approved for use on humans

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Control Company Temperature Data Logger with GO Wireless Capability and Calibration; Platinum Probe
PRODUCT_NAME: Control Company Temperature Data Logger with GO Wireless Capability and Calibration; Platinum Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Bluetooth device is the ideal transit partner for monitoring materials between destinations. Safely transport reagents, clinical samples, vaccines, pharmaceuticals and food items to any location. With the TraceableGO mobile app, view if an alarm was triggered, generate an instant data report. Device stores up to 90 alarm events, records readings once every 5 minutes by default, or the user may adjust the reading interval between one minute to once every 12 hours, logging duration is 227 days (7.5 months). TraceableGO™ Bluetooth devices are pre-programmed with alarm values. Broad compatibility easy Bluetooth connection works with any Bluetooth-enabled devices. Once TraceableGO™ arrives, enable the Bluetooth transfer to a smartphone, open the TraceableGO™ app (available on iTunes or Google Play) pair the device to smartphone download the recorded data since the device was enabled and send a report directly from a mobile device. Supplied with traceable certificate, batteries, quick start guide, wall mount.

• Press START to begin trip monitoring
• Place device inside a small cooler or even an entire pallet of material
• Once the trip has ended, double-press START/STOP to enable Bluetooth and export the data using the TraceableGO™ mobile app
• TraceableGO mobile app immediately identifies if the contents experienced conditions outside user-defined parameters

Traceable® Certificate:
Multi-point calibration on an individually-numbered Traceable® Certificate which assures accuracy from an ISO/IEC 17025:2005 (1750.01) calibration laboratory accredited by A2LA. It indicates traceability of measurements to the SI units through NIST or other recognized national measurement institutes (NMI) that are signatories to the CIPM Mutual Recognition Agreement.

Four Probe Options Available:
• Ambient Sensor: Temperature range -20 to 70°C (-4 to 158°F), resolution: 0.1, accuracy: +/-0.4°C between -10 and 70°C, otherwise +/-0.5°C.

• Bottle Probe Sensor: Temperature range -50.00 to 70.00°C (-58.00 to 158.00°F), resolution: 0.1, accuracy: +/-0.3°C. Temperature-buffered glycol bottle probe mimics solution-Bottle and solution insulate sensor from rapid changes, as an example, when a refrigerator door is opened. Solution mimics temperature of stored samples. Probe is sealed in a miniature bottle (1 x 2-1/2 inches) filled with nontoxic glycol. Solution is GRAS (generally recognized as safe) by the FDA (Food and Drug Administration).

• Bullet Probe Sensor: Temperature range -50.00 to 70.00°C (-58.00 to 158.00°F), resolution: 0.1, accuracy: +/-0.3°C. Small sized plastic probe with cable 0.19 inch diameter x 0.75 inches long. Designed for use in air and liquids, the sensor and cable may be completely immersed.

• Platinum RTD Probe Sensor: Temperature range -90.00 to 100.00°C (-130.00 to 212.00°F), resolution: 0.1, accuracy: +/-0.2°C. Monitor temperatures below -80°C ensuring critical samples are not compromised, 9 ft. FEP cable
